name: Intake Queue Stalled Assignment Escalation
description: Escalates submitted applications that have remained unassigned in the regional intake queue past the SLA limit.

tiers.description: Level 1: Case unassigned 1 day past 3-day SLA. High priority alert to Section Supervisor.
Level 2: Case unassigned 3 days past SLA. Escalated to Central Bureau Officer and Regional Director.
tiers.actionRequired: Central bureau intervention to reassign regional intake queue.

autoResolutionCondition: Application stage moves from SUBMITTED to SCRUTINY with assigned_scrutiny_officer_id populated.
